equipment_type: Thermal energy meter (BACnet MS/TP plug-in module)
applies_to: Danfoss SonoMeter 40 ultrasonic heat/cooling energy meters fitted with the BACnet MS/TP module.
summary: The BACnet MS/TP module plugs into a SonoMeter 40 energy meter, reads the meter over its internal bus at a set interval and serves the values as 14 read-only Analog Inputs: energy and tariff registers, volumes, pulse inputs, power, flow, the two temperatures and an info code. It is a B-ASC powered from 12-24 V AC/DC.
default_device_instance: Last 5 digits of the meter serial number
notes: Units are listed as alternatives (e.g. kWh or MWh); the meter's configuration sets which one applies.
Names with a slash (e.g. 'Tariff 1 / Energy 2') carry one value or the other depending on meter type.
Instances are not contiguous: AI 0-6, 8, 11, 14, 19-21 and 30.
The device object list printed in the same document stops at AI 11, which conflicts with the object table; check on site.
The module is made by Axioma Metering and reports vendor ID 1006.

source.title: Operating guide, BACnet MS/TP Module for energy meter SonoMeter 40

integration.summary: Read the heating and cooling energy totals, power, flow and the two temperatures, and watch AI 30 for meter errors. Values only refresh at the module's update interval (300 s by default), so poll or trend no faster than that.

minimum_points.name: Accumulated cooling energy (E2) / Energy 1
minimum_points.why: Cooling energy total (Energy 1 on some meters)

minimum_points.name: Actual power
minimum_points.why: Thermal power, W, kW or MW

setup: Default device instance is the last 5 digits of the meter serial number; the device name defaults to 'Danfoss BACnet'.
MS/TP MAC 1-127; default is the last 2 digits of the serial number or the meter's 'M-Bus 2' address.
Max-master 127 and max-info-frames 2 are writable; no segmentation.
Wiring: terminals 90 (A+) and 91 (B-), power on 60/61 at 12-24 V AC/DC.
Holding SET while powering up for about 12 s resets the module settings (address, baud).
gotchas: Data refresh interval is 300 s by default (configurable); readings between updates do not change.
The serial line is 8E1 by default, not the more common 8N1.
The document gives no meanings for the AI 30 info codes; use the meter manual.

points.name: Accumulated cooling energy (E2) / Energy 1
points.description: Cooling energy, or Energy 1, depending on meter type

points.name: Tariff 1 / Energy 2
points.description: Tariff 1 register, or Energy 2, depending on meter type

points.name: Pulse input A accumulated / Accumulated volume (V2)
points.description: Pulse input A total, or volume V2

points.description: Pulse input B total, or volume V3
